root_idea.summary: The root is oriented toward gathering or aggregation together with smallness and lightness.
root_idea.development: From the image of small, lightly moving creatures gathered together, the lexicon develops related uses for ants, ant-affected food, light-footedness, spreading sores, and the fingertips.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural أَنَامِل is presented under the supported singular citation form أُنْمُلَة.
This is the Quranic singular noun نَمْلَة, distinct from the plural/collective نَمْل.
نَمْل is a supported plural or collective noun and is retained as its own dictionary form.

senses.definition: Fingertip; the terminal part or nail-bearing joint of a finger.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural أَنَامِل, referring to the fingertips.
Singular noun; in the Quranic passage, it denotes the individual ant addressing the other ants.

senses.definition: Ants; the plural or collective designation of the ant.
senses.usage_conditions: Plural or collective noun, explicitly treated as the plural of نَمْلَة; the Quran uses its genitive and nominative forms in 27:18.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Formication: a tingling, stinging, or prickling sensation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited lexical example is the sensation associated with a torpedo fish.
A conventional expression referring to red ants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food into which ants have entered or which has been affected by ants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression طَعَامٌ مَنْمُولٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sore appearing on the side, named by resemblance to an ant in its appearance and spreading.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct medical or bodily use of نَمْلَة, not the insect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A crack in a horse’s hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct equine use of نَمْلَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Light-footed or light in the legs, said of a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction فَرَسٌ نَمِلُ القَوَائِمِ, by comparison with the light movement of ants.
A figurative use based on the creeping or spreading movement associated with ants; the cited forms include نَمِلٌ, ذُو نَمْلَةٍ, and نَمَّالٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disperse among people in order to gather, like ants spreading out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative construction describing a group’s dispersal for gathering.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form V formication or stinging use.
Fingertip and terminal finger-joint meaning represented by the Quranic plural.

cautions: The Quranic form أَنَامِل is presented under the normalized singular citation form أُنْمُلَة; the supplied Lane evidence also records the variant spelling أَنْمَلَة.
